svg.title: Bazaar Sanctuary
svg.desc: 3 ordinary entrances · 22 × 20 m court · dry sill +0 m
svg.text: 3 ordinary entrances · 22 × 20 m court · dry sill +0 m
INCOMING ANGLE AND TWO INDEPENDENT POCKETS
C11 Receipt shutter / C12 Bale bench
C15 Cart chest / C13 Stamp screen
C16 Market register / C14 Measure post
Bearings turn clockwise from north at the threshold.
Solid fill marks tall cover. Diagonal hatching marks low cover. Dots mark permeable set dressing.
Strokes run from full-body cover through a shoulder mark to a peek. The 4.5 m ritual apron stays clear.
Dashed copper paths show the two independent Sluice walks with the alternate pocket occupied.
Two 0.65 m movement envelopes pass each mouth.
Ground concealment depends on the viewing angle.
See sheet 03 for the raised observer and stance changes.
Source: registered Mandala floor GLB and cover survey. Plan coordinates use metres east and north.
